name: Ecuador
administering_agency: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores y Movilidad Humana

format.notes: Questions are drawn at random by the ministry’s system from a bank written by a committee (history, culture, geography and the country today).

exemptions.age: Minors are excused. Older adults (adultos mayores) are excused from the examination but must still speak and write Spanish.
exemptions.disability: People with an intellectual disability that deprives them of the use of reason are excused.

unverified.official_study_material: The question bank is internal; nothing published was found.
unverified.format.question_count: Reported as 30 questions with 27 needed; the figure was not found in the text read.

recent_change.summary: The procedure page now cites the Reglamento a la Ley Orgánica de Movilidad Humana of 2025 as its legal basis; the earlier rules came from a 2022 ministerial agreement.
